description: Search the official SEC company ticker reference data by issuer name, ticker, or CIK and return bounded normalized candidates. When a CIK is unknown, select a matching candidate and pass its cik to get_sec_filings in a separate paid request. This reference list is not a complete registry of every U.S. legal entity. Price: $0.0058 production USDC via x402 on Base mainnet. Example arguments: {"query":"Apple","limit":10}.
name: search_sec_company
